steps.title: Producing Messages
steps.text: A producer sends messages to topics. Each message has a key, a value, optional headers, and a timestamp. Producers are your entry point for getting data into Surgewave.

steps.title: Code Example: Producer
steps.text: Lesson 1.1 walks you through creating your first producer. You will learn to send messages with keys for routing and values containing your data payload.

steps.title: Consuming Messages
steps.text: Consumers read messages from topics. They track their position using offsets, so they can resume where they left off after a restart. Lesson 1.2 covers the consumer API.

steps.title: Partitions Enable Parallelism
steps.text: Topics are divided into partitions for horizontal scaling. Each partition is an ordered, append-only log. Messages with the same key always land in the same partition, guaranteeing per-key ordering.

steps.title: Hands-On Exercises
steps.text: Start with Lesson 1.1 to produce your first messages, then move through consumers, partitions, and consumer groups. Each lesson includes runnable code you can experiment with.
